name: Rise Up Surf Retreats
summary: Rise Up Surf Retreats runs week-long, all-inclusive surf and yoga retreats, currently in Nicaragua and Costa Rica. Its Barbados retreat, at a seven bedroom villa on the Platinum Coast, still has a page on the site but no dates, and it is not on the booking page.
checkNotes: Looks closed: the Barbados retreat appears to be no longer offered, though the company itself is trading (journal posts dated October 2026, retreats booked into 2027 in Nicaragua and Costa Rica). Evidence: the site menu lists only Costa Rica, Nicaragua and a speciality retreat; the home page and booking page describe retreats in Central America only; the booking page (https://www.riseupsurf.com/book/) lists dates for every other retreat and none for Barbados; the Barbados page's Availability block shows 'BarBados 2026' with no dates. The Barbados page is still live and reachable from /all-retreats/. For a fact-checker, that page says: founder Phil was born in Barbados; villa on the Platinum Coast with 7 en-suite bedrooms, pool and private access to Sandy Lane beach; maximum 8 guests; 2:1 guest to coach ratio; 6 days of surf coaching and video analysis or theory; all surf equipment except rash guards; four meals daily; round-trip airport transport at set times; daily yoga, breath work and mobility; two ice baths a week; catamaran cruise, beach horse riding and sunset glass bottom boat trip; retreats run Saturday to Saturday; Double Room $4750, all prices per person in USD. The site's catamaran description mentions swimming with sea turtles (not feeding). Booking on the site goes through a WeTravel widget for the other retreats. The phone number is a Nicaraguan (+505) number. No media file written, per the brief for closed listings.
